relationship_to_mother: One fixed causal translation of ASHARE-ANNUAL-AMIHUD-ILLIQUIDITY-COMPENSATION-MOTHER-V1 after every chronological and outcome-group chart sheet was reviewed.

visual_review.compression: The stable visual abstraction was a dynamically observed transfer into an accepted higher price area, conditioned on causal broad-market opportunity and followed by one deterministic loss-of-acceptance exit. Static signal-date trend, named candles, single rebounds, and single breakouts were rejected by material counterexamples.

five_rules: Mother set: retain the already-frozen highest annual Amihud quintile formed from the complete preceding calendar year with at least 200 valid daily observations.

Observation clock: do not buy at the annual signal. From the first possible causal 20-session stock window through signal_cal_idx+120, recompute the causal market state after each close; STRONG means market_median_ret20>0 and WEAK means market_median_ret20<=0.

Accepted repricing trigger: take the first close for which at least 15 of the stock's most recent 20 valid traded coordinate closes are strictly above the frozen annual-signal coordinate close and current stock ret20 is strictly greater than max(0, causal market_median_ret20). The same frozen coordinate lineage must hold throughout the observation history.
Entry: after a trigger close, buy only at the first legal non-limit-up open in trigger_cal_idx+1 through trigger_cal_idx+3. A trigger that cannot obtain such an entry is not a completed signal.

Exit: after entry, the first close completing five consecutive valid traded closes strictly below each close's own causal rolling median of the most recent 20 valid traded coordinate closes generates a failure exit for the next legal non-limit-down open. Otherwise exit at the first legal non-limit-down open on or after entry_cal_idx+120.

timing_and_execution.trigger_available: Only after the trigger-session close and after all source timestamps are at or before that session decision_at.
timing_and_execution.entry: First legal non-limit-up open one to three market sessions strictly after the trigger close.
timing_and_execution.failure_exit: First legal non-limit-down open strictly after the fifth qualifying failure close.
timing_and_execution.time_exit: First legal non-limit-down open on or after entry_cal_idx+120.
timing_and_execution.suspensions_and_price_limits: Preserve existing accepted legal-open and limit-price checks.
timing_and_execution.corporate_actions_and_coordinate_lineage: Require the frozen signal invalid_step_cum coordinate lineage through trigger, entry, and exit; fail closed immediately on drift or unknown required lineage.

market_state_semantics.representation: Causal cross-sectional median 20-session stock return, recomputed at the actual trigger date.
market_state_semantics.purpose: In a weak market the stock must itself have positive 20-session return; in a strong market it must exceed the positive market median. This is a single asymmetric proof rule, not a hindsight annual label.

success_gate.if_pass: Freeze unchanged and only then open the 2022-2024 validation partition.
success_gate.if_fail: Close this exact family without threshold, window, exit, or market-state rescue and continue to a genuinely different economic mother family.
